name: Major cyber incidents
value: France blames IRGC unit for store sabotage
summary: France blamed an IRGC-linked unit on 10 Nov for October hacks on about 700 stores' fridges; Poland hit 10 Nov
state: France has attributed the 11–12 Oct attacks on refrigeration systems at about 700 sites to Shahid Kaveh, an offensive cyber unit linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guards, naming three alleged perpetrators; Iran denies it (Al Jazeera, 10 Nov). Similar attacks hit stores in Belgium, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands and Luxembourg on 2 Nov, with no attribution yet (The Record). Poland took its national ePUAP government services platform offline after a cyberattack disclosed on 10 Nov (The Record). A destructive state-attributed attack keeps the Alert.
for_you: Retail and building-control systems connected to the internet are being targeted. Organisations should follow NCSC guidance on securing operational technology and remote access.
rubric_hit: Alert: destructive state-attributed attack (France attributes store sabotage to IRGC-linked unit, 10 Nov)
